items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The personal belongings were also in a vehicle away from the insured location, so §§4.3(d), 4.3(f) and 4.5 independently leave no payable amount.
The private car is excluded under §4.3(e), and vehicle-related expenses are expressly excluded under §5.2.5. No amount is payable.
